No keys, health data, response bodies or operation history persisted to Storage or analytics.
proposed_frontend_ownership.web/static/js/api.js (usuario helpers on: generarPlan(operationKey) requires/sends Idempotency-Key; descargarPlan(planId) validates int32 ID and delegates to the existing fenced PDF transport with the personal endpoint path.
proposed_frontend_ownership.tests/e2e/personal_generation.cjs and de: Own tests on the frozen current runtime; independent reviewer retains accepted suites untouched.

observed_contract.POST /api/usuario/generar-plan: Authenticated, no request body; Idempotency-Key scopes the persisted reservation to personal user.id. Same key completed replay returns persisted plan. Current response lacks plan_id.
observed_contract.GET /api/usuario/mi-plan: Latest plan plus meta/tiene_pdf; currently lacks plan_id. Reading latest is acceptable for display but cannot identify a previous displayed result for PDF download.
observed_contract.GET /api/usuario/historial: Rows already carry exact id and tiene_pdf.
observed_contract.GET /api/usuario/descargar-pdf?plan_id={: Already accepts positive int32 ID and checks personal owner/client. Use this path for individual and legacy professional-member personal scope; no fallback to the professional parent gym or latest plan.
observed_contract.error_codes: Observed generation_in_progress, generation_failed, generation_result_unavailable, generation_reconciliation_required, monthly_plan_limit, invalid_idempotency_key and profile validation errors. Confirm final replay-legacy behavior after backend freeze.

requested_backend_delta: Return persisted plan_id in both _individual_plan_response (fresh/completed replay) and get_mi_plan. A known no-plan result must use plan_id:null or omit it consistently. No schema/DDL needed for this DTO delta.
Keep existing personal exact-ID PDF endpoint, no-store attachment and owner checks. Do not synthesize an ID from response time, list position or latest after an ambiguous POST.
Confirm the final failure/replay contract and any terminal credit/refund statement; frontend must not infer refunded credit from an HTTP failure.
operation_behavior: Create one in-memory UUID for an explicit generation action and disable duplicate submissions. A transport timeout/unknown outcome retains that key; same-operation retry reuses it. Never regenerate automatically on GET/history refresh.

Unconfirmed/pending/reconciliation states offer consult history and retry the same operation where permitted. A new key requires an explicit new-operation action and cost warning; profile edits must not silently replace a pending key.
A completed response is rendered only after validating plan_id/shape and unchanged personal subject/session. Keep that exact ID for download even if a newer plan is generated later.

Refresh rotation under the same accepted session is allowed by the central transport; account/scope/SV change, storage failure or page invalidation discards old responses, keys and personal DOM, closes dialogs and revokes Blob URLs. Old finally handlers cannot reactivate controls for a new epoch.

Use visible status/error regions, focusable recovery actions and keyboard/320px checks. Do not promise a saved file, finished generation, refunded credit or available quota without backend confirmation.
acceptance_plan: Real login, profile, generation replay and exact historical PDF from current frozen backend, including professional-member personal scope and foreign-plan denial.
Auth/refresh failure, held generation/profile/history/PDF success and error across account changes, same key/unchanged payload on retry, duplicate click, no new key after unknown outcome.
Clearly labeled transport doubles for timeout/pending/reconciliation states, plus stale-account/Blob cleanup, accessibility and overflow checks. No providers or email.
separate_open_work: R10 reload/cross-tab atomicity of legacy keys remains open.
R14 diary persistence, Mexico City dates and legacy local activity keys require their separate contract; no automatic migration/deletion is proposed here.
No broad base/nav/auth writer change is included in this proposal.
snapshot_limit: Backend files are being finalized concurrently; observed hashes are an inspection record, not a backend/runtime freeze.
